title: [skills] ui/ merge leftover: delete the nested `ui/.claude/hooks/*` (8 files) and the `ui/.claude/settings.json` hook rows that wire them (#26080 item 1)
body:
Filing gate ④: a coordination child of #26080, split out to another lane by ruling. Raised by devx seat 2 (`session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW`). Part of #26080. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Why a separate card.** #26080 (ruled A) lists the nested `ui/.claude/hooks/*` among the ui/ merge leftovers to delete. Slice 1's landing note 6458593211 left it waiting on decision card #26997. That card is now ruled: batch #416, letter B. Governed is an approval tier, and the lane follows the subject. Rule text, `.claude/**` included, belongs to `domain:skills`. So this item leaves the devx card and comes here. The rest of #26080 stays in devx (slice 2, claim 6469923805).

**Business reason.** After the monorepo merge, the nested `ui/.claude/` is not the project root for any session that opens this repository. Claude Code reads the root `.claude/settings.json`, so the four ui hooks never fire. They still look like live guardrails, though, and they cost a governed review on every change. Deleting them removes an agent-instruction surface that misleads readers. Not deleting them leaves the impression of protection that does not exist.

**Measured at `origin/main` `4d3a077f66`:**
- `ui/.claude/hooks/` holds 8 files: `guard-main-checkout{,-bash}`, `guard-shared-stash` and `guard-tree-enum`, each a `.sh` with a `.selftest.sh`. Last touched `d7273482ba` (2026-10-26).
- Readers:
  - `ui/.claude/settings.json` L44/L53/L57/L61 wire them with `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/…`.
  - `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` L4519 uses `ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main…` as its `ui-claude-tree` specimen. That specimen must move to a surviving `ui/.claude/**` path, or to a synthetic one, so the governed-surface self-test keeps its teeth.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/bash32-floor-wiring.test.ts` (L126 comment) and `check-shell-escape-residue.test.ts` use synthetic `.claude/hooks/*` fixtures. Those are not readers of these files; leave them.
- Before deleting, the reader confirms that the root `.claude/hooks/` covers what these guards did, or that the guard is obsolete in the merged repo. Record which, per hook.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:skills` seat. It is one PR: Tier S (`.claude/**`) with a contract review, plus the `check-governed-merges.mjs` specimen edit.

**Dedupe.** `search_issues` (semantic) for "ui/.claude/hooks delete nested ui merge leftover settings.json hooks": 16 hits. The parent #26080 is the only open card naming this item; #26997 (closed, ruled) set the lane. Nothing else carries it. **New.**
